```blade
<div>
    <div class="flex justify-center items-center h-screen">
        @livewire('search-bookmarks')
        <table class="w-full border-collapse mt-5">
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th class="border p-2">Title</th>
                    <th class="border p-2">Author</th>
                    <th class="border p-2">Status</th>
                    <th class="border p-2">Actions</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody wire:key="bookmarks">
                @foreach ($bookmarks as $bookmark)
                    <tr class="border text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100">
                        <td class="border p-2">{{ $bookmark->title }}</td>
                        <td class="border p-2">{{ $bookmark->author }}</td>
                        <td class="border p-2">{{ $bookmark->status }}</td>
                        <td class="border p-2 flex items-center justify-center">
                            <button wire:click="toggleBookmark({{ $bookmark->id }})" class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700">
                                {{ $bookmark->is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive' }}
                            </button>
                            <button wire:click="$emit('delete-bookmark', {{ $bookmark->id }})" class="ml-4 px-4 py-2 bg-red-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-red-700">
                                Delete
                            </button>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                @endforeach
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>
```
